clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, Remtravel's excavations set a search in motion. In Menethil Harbor, Archaeologist Flagongut hopes to join Remtravel's finds with his own fossil and the lost Stone of Relu to reveal the relics' hidden powers.

You once helped the distracted Prospector Remtravel during an escort through northern Darkshore. His search now reaches across the Great Sea to the Wetlands marshes, where Prospector Whelgar keeps Flagongut's original fossil at his excavation site. After reviewing the collected finds, Archaeologist Flagongut believes a key artifact, the Stone of Relu, can unlock the mysterious powers within the fossils.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Prospector Whelgar now holds the original fossil at his site in the Wetlands. When I discovered the Stone of Relu, I believed it to be the key to unlocking the mystery of the fossil.

While I traveled on the road to meet Whelgar, I was attacked by raptors and the relic was lost. I don't know which one of the mottled beasts swallowed the relic but if you can retrieve it, I can unleash the power of these artifacts.
Bring me both the Stone of Relu, and the original fossil he holds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: With the Stone of Relu I will be able to release the hidden secrets of my fossil as well as Remtravel's fossil from Darkshore, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now to see if I can use the stone to decipher the powers of the fossils.
